scope: Bounded independent final release-delta quality/security review only: evidence-copy helper, index links, Atlas V8 catalogue/binary identity, README/release notes, and catalogue/evidence regression tests. Not model-confirmation completion, deployment, broad release verification or promotion authorization.

priorScopePreservation.method: Hashed every current file against original quality-final source map. Reviewed actual before/after unified diffs for both changed files against preserved reviewed source. Index delta is documentation/results/source links only; build delta is copyEvidence export/imports and replacement of two evaluation-directory copies. Original app/worker/CLI/book/fetcher/test code is unchanged.

checks.evidenceSafety: copyEvidence recursively identifies case-insensitive .html/.htm, checks source alias collisions before copying, filters original HTML paths, copies original bytes to extension-appended .txt names, and writes SHA256 original/published mapping. Both site and laptop evidence copies use this helper. Original repository evidence is not modified. Fresh temporary-fixture tests exercise nested HTML, digest equality, JSON preservation, uppercase HTML, .htm and collision-before-copy rejection. No real build was run.
checks.catalogue: Compared old manifest from git HEAD with current manifest: every previous sparse descriptor is unchanged; Atlas V8 is the sole model addition. active.json selects pocket-plus and atlas-v8. Existing build filtering publishes only active sparse binaries, and existing resolveModel supports atlas alias when only atlas-v8 remains in the package. Source tree deliberately retains all nine sparse IDs.
checks.catalogueRegression: Only exact expected source IDs changed in laptop-catalog test; per-model successful execution and legal-move assertions are unchanged. Fresh test ran all nine actual sparse models with book disabled; no heavy ML or training was performed.
checks.documentation: README and RELEASE-V8 consistently identify Atlas derivative/hash, 25 versus 21 teacher matches over 96 final positions, equal four losses, unchanged Pocket/DeepMind, separate book layer, and no Elo/stronger-play claim. Statistical counts are provided/parent-reviewed context, not independently recomputed in this delta review. Runtime-freeze/replay limitations remain linked.
checks.index: Only links/labels changed relative to prior scoped approval; no new script, event handler or dynamic HTML. Current release/book/results/source targets use fixed URLs.

executedCommands.command: git diff -- tools/build.mjs public/index.html public/models/manifest.json public/models/active.json README.md tests/laptop-catalog.test.mjs && git rev-parse HEAD

executedCommands.description: Directly called actual copyEvidence with upper.HTML and short.htm, asserted byte-identical text aliases and omission of originals, then added short.htm.txt and asserted collision rejection before destination creation.

suggestions: Published .txt evidence relies on normal static-host text/plain handling for .txt. Do not override these aliases to text/html; no host MIME verification or deployment was performed here.
Evidence documents can retain historical links to original .html names. HTML-EVIDENCE.json supplies the mapping; a future documentation-only change can make distributed alias links easier to follow.

copyEvidence is reviewed as a fresh-output build helper over repository-owned evidence, not an untrusted-upload sanitizer or an in-place cleaner of previously populated destinations. buildSite removes its output trees first.
limitations: No production changes, network, browser, full build, training, heavy ML, commit or push by this reviewer.
No broad test round or independent replay of 13528 runtime bindings/20 games. Full model-confirmation completion is owned by the separate reviewer and is not approved by this receipt.
Unsafe auto-publishing CLI removal is reported as separately underway; no approval is granted for that tool or its removal by this narrowly scoped verdict.
Prior browser/package evidence is not relabeled current after Atlas catalogue and documentation changes. Final build, extracted-artifact checks, deployment and delivery remain parent-owned.
summary: PASS for the frozen named release deltas: safe inert-text evidence copying, link-only UI changes, exact Atlas V8 artifact/catalogue identity, and preserved original scope; no security or logic blocker found.
